newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank revises May industrial production down.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank revises May industrial production down.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Thursday it revised its May German industrial production data downward to show an index level of 99.3 compared with 100.6 in its preliminary report.
The central bank also revised its industrial production figure for west Germany downward to 95.8 from 97.1 and the production figure for east Germany to 146.1 from 147.1.
In April the German industrial production index stood at 100.8. In west Germany the index was at 97.5 and the index stood at 146.7 for east Germany.
